# M9-S1: lint severities, the //logos:allow directive, [lints] in logos.toml,
# logos lint, and --json-diagnostics on loGo/s packages.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

mkdir $WORK/bin

# A deny violation fails logos build and names the rule at file:line:col.
cd deny
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/deny$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/deny$GOEXE
cd ..

# //logos:allow(<rule>) before the statement silences a deny rule.
cd allow
logos build -o $WORK/bin/allow$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/allow$GOEXE
cd ..

# The same directive on a forbid rule is itself an error, and forbid
# ignores it: the rule is reported as well.
cd forbid
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/forbid$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:3:1: \[correctness::allow_forbidden_rule\]'
stderr 'main\.lgo:4:6: \[correctness::infinite_recursion\]'
! exists $WORK/bin/forbid$GOEXE
cd ..

# logos.toml slop = "warn" turns the deny rule into a warning: the build
# passes and still prints the rule.
cd warn
logos build -o $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: warning: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
exists $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE

# A cached rebuild replays the warning.
logos build -o $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: warning: \[slop::discarded_error\]'

# A JSON build after the text builds prints JSON, not the replayed text:
# the output format is part of the action ID.
logos build --json-diagnostics -o $WORK/bin/warn$GOEXE .
! stderr '^#'
! stderr 'warning:'
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*"rule_id":"slop::discarded_error".*\}$'
cd ..

# slop = "allow" is silent.
cd quiet
logos build -o $WORK/bin/quiet$GOEXE .
! stderr .
exists $WORK/bin/quiet$GOEXE
cd ..

# A forbid group cannot be lowered by configuration.
cd lowered
! logos build .
stderr 'logos\.toml:2:15: \[configuration::forbid_lowered\] correctness cannot be lowered below forbid'
cd ..

# logos lint ./... reports without building binaries and fails on deny.
cd lintcmd
! logos lint ./...
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
! exists lintcmd
! exists lintcmd$GOEXE
cd ..

# logos lint of a clean module is silent and writes nothing.
cd clean
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
! stdout .
! exists clean
! exists clean$GOEXE
cd ..

# logos build --json-diagnostics prints one JSON object per line with the
# schema fields; TestLogosJSONDiagnostics checks each line as JSON.
cd jsonbuild
! logos build --json-diagnostics -o $WORK/bin/jsonbuild$GOEXE .
! stderr '^#'
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
cd ..

# logos lint --json-diagnostics reports the same records, and the forbid
# directive error carries severity forbid;
# TestLogosJSONDiagnostics checks the records as JSON.
cd jsonlint
! logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cd ..

# A warn rule has severity warn in the JSON output and does not fail;
# TestLogosJSONDiagnostics checks the record as JSON.
cd jsonwarn
logos lint --json-diagnostics ./...
cd ..

# A Go type error under logos build --json-diagnostics is one valid record
# for the .go file with an empty rule_id;
# TestLogosJSONDiagnostics checks the record as JSON.
cd gotypeerr
! logos build --json-diagnostics ./...
! stderr '^#'
stderr -count=1 '^\{.*\}$'
cd ..

# A logos.toml change recompiles: the policy is part of the action ID, so
# the build cache cannot hide a stricter severity.
cd reconfig
logos build -o $WORK/bin/reconfig$GOEXE .
! stderr .
cp logos-deny.toml logos.toml
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/reconfig$GOEXE .
stderr 'main\.lgo:6:2: \[slop::discarded_error\]'
cd ..

# A loGo/s dependency module, not the main module, gets no lint diagnostic.
cd lgoapp
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lgoapp$GOEXE .
! stderr .
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
cd ..

# Plain go has neither the lint command nor the JSON flag.
cd clean
! go lint ./...
stderr 'go lint: unknown command'
! go build --json-diagnostics ./...
stderr 'flag provided but not defined: -json-diagnostics'
go help build
! stdout 'json-diagnostics'
cd ..

-- deny/go.mod --
module example.com/deny

go 1.27

-- deny/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- allow/go.mod --
module example.com/allow

go 1.27

-- allow/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- forbid/go.mod --
module example.com/forbid

go 1.27

-- forbid/main.lgo --
package main

//logos:allow(correctness::infinite_recursion)
func loop(n int) int {
	return loop(n)
}

func main() {
	println(loop(1))
}

-- warn/go.mod --
module example.com/warn

go 1.27

-- warn/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "warn"

-- warn/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- quiet/go.mod --
module example.com/quiet

go 1.27

-- quiet/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "allow"

-- quiet/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- reconfig/go.mod --
module example.com/reconfig

go 1.27

-- reconfig/logos.toml --
[lints]
slop = "allow"

-- reconfig/logos-deny.toml --
[lints]
slop = "deny"

-- reconfig/main.lgo --
package main

import "os"

func main() {
	os.Remove("missing")
}

-- lgoapp/go.mod --
module example.com/lgoapp

go 1.27

require example.com/lgodep v0.0.0

replace example.com/lgodep => ../lgodep

-- lgoapp/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/lgodep"

func main() {
	println(lgodep.Name())
}

-- lgodep/go.mod --
module example.com/lgodep

go 1.27

-- lgodep/dep.lgo --
package lgodep

import "os"

func Name() string {
	os.Remove("missing")
	return "dep"
}

-- lowered/go.mod --
module example.com/lowered

go 1.27

-- lowered/logos.toml --
[lints]
correctness = "warn"

-- lowered/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- gotypeerr/go.mod --
module example.com/gotypeerr

go 1.27

-- gotypeerr/main.go --
package main

func main() {
	undefinedFn()
}
